verdict.rationale: Google Voice's docs say users can link their Voice number to any mobile or landline number and use Voice on smartphones, which covers forwarding the business number to a cell. Ring groups also let several people answer calls to the same business number. Missing for 10: documented conditional or scheduled forwarding (e.g., working-hours or away rules), a detailed forwarding setup guide, and independent hands-on confirmation of business-number forwarding to a cell.
